tagline: HF Sinclair Corporation is an independent energy company producing refined products, renewable fuels, and specialty lubricants.
hero_kpi_rationale: As an independent oil company, net revenue reflects the performance of the refining and marketing segments, influenced by refining margins, fuel prices, and demand for refined petroleum products.

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of refined petroleum products and related services.
kpis.description: This KPI measures total revenue including sales of refined petroleum products, renewable fuels, and specialty products.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of growth and operational performance.

kpis.name: Refining Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Refining gross margin per barrel of crude oil produced, adjusted for regional impacts.
kpis.description: Adjusted refining gross margin per barrel sold reflects refining efficiency and the impact of market conditions, up 47% in 2025.
kpis.signal: Indicates profitability of refining operations and ability to capture market spreads.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Operating income evaluates the company's performance before interest and taxes.
kpis.signal: Measures profitability of core business activities.

kpis.name: Net Income Attributable to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Net profit after taxes, attributable to HF Sinclair shareholders.
kpis.description: Net income attributable to shareholders represents the final result after all expenses, taxes, and interest.
kpis.signal: Measures the final profitability of the company available to shareholders.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (CAPEX)
kpis.explanation: Capital spending for the acquisition or upgrading of physical assets.
kpis.description: CAPEX for 2025 includes investments in scheduled turnarounds at the Parco, Puget Sound, and Tulsa refineries, as well as operational improvements.
kpis.signal: Reflects investments in future production capacity and refinery turnarounds.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated from the company's operating activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow measures cash generated from core operations before investments and financing.
kpis.signal: Indicator of the ability to generate cash from operations.

kpis.name: EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization)
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.
kpis.description: EBITDA is calculated as net income to shareholders plus taxes, net interest, and depreciation/amortization.
kpis.signal: Measures operational profitability adjusted for non-cash items.

kpis.name: Headcount (Employees)
kpis.description: Headcount is an indicator of operational size and human resource needs.
kpis.signal: May indicate company growth or restructuring.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions risks related to cybersecurity, data security, and privacy in its annual report.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict environmental and energy regulations, including the Renewable Fuel Standard, which could have a significant impact on its costs and operations.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in litigation and legal proceedings, including with the EPA, which could impact its operations and reputation.

risks.title: Environmental
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to environmental risks, including pollution and waste, which could impact its operations and reputation.

risks.title: Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks of volatility in raw material and product prices, which could impact its operations and financial results.

risks.title: Regulatory Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is dependent on government regulation, particularly regarding subsidies and tax credits, which could impact its operations and financial results.
